scope: Inventory/structural validation of all 26 user-provided SRT files; manually reviewed selected strategic excerpts. No audio verification, full-corpus semantic review, rules adoption, training or deployment.

metadata_source.kind: previously downloaded public RSS; no network refresh in this curation
metadata_source.published_at_meaning: date reported by saved RSS, not verified original recording date

inventory_digest_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 concatenation of sha256 + two spaces + filename + LF, sorted by filename
duration_note: Sum of final subtitle endpoints, not exact audio duration or speech completeness.
review_range_selection: Inclusive comparison of HH:MM:SS cue starts with recorded start/end. Duplicates count once in reviewed_unique_cue_count. An unlisted keyword snippet is not counted as contiguous review.
